settings.store.code.duplicate: Not saved: another store of the business already uses this code.
settings.store.code.hint: Up to 12 characters, unique among the stores; used in labels and the cost CSV. Leave it empty for no code.
settings.store.code.label: Store code
settings.store.eInvoice.hint: The Data quality page, coming soon, will name a store that has not registered e-invoices.
settings.store.eInvoice.label: E-invoices
settings.store.empty: No store is in your scope yet.
settings.store.hours.hint: Saving the opening hours changes Hours and weekdays, Today's opening-hour figures, when the sync runs during the day and when the digest is sent.
settings.store.hours.invalid: Not saved: the opening hours are not valid; check the time spans.
settings.store.hours.label: Opening hours
settings.store.hours.ownerOnly: Not saved: only an owner of the store can change its opening hours, because they decide the alerts and the sync schedule.
settings.store.hours.readOnly: Only an owner of the store can change its opening hours, because they decide the alerts and the sync schedule.
settings.store.hours.unset: No opening hours entered yet: every day is empty. Untick “Closed all day” on a day to add its hours.
settings.store.intro: The profile of the business and of each store: the opening-hour figures, RevPASH, alerts and the compliance checks read it.
settings.store.language.hint: Members who have not chosen a language open the app in this one; the VI/EN switch still changes it on each device.
settings.store.language.label: Default language
settings.store.legalForm.checked: Checked against the rules as of 12/11/2026; not legal advice.
settings.store.legalForm.hint: The legal form decides the dossier for transferring personal data abroad, because customer data is stored on servers outside Vietnam: household businesses and micro-enterprises are exempt, and small enterprises may defer to 2030 (Personal Data Protection Law, Articles 20, 21, 38; Decree 356/2025).
settings.store.legalForm.label: Legal form
settings.store.member.hint: Whether the POS records member customers on the receipts.
settings.store.member.label: Member feature on the POS
settings.store.openedOn.hint: Lines up the comparisons of stores by days since opening.
settings.store.openedOn.label: Opening date
settings.store.pos.name: Store name
settings.store.pos.why: The name, address and time zone come from the POS sync, and the business-day start decides the date of every sale, so they are not edited here.
settings.store.readOnly.role: Only the owners and managers of this store can change its profile; you are viewing it read-only.
settings.store.readOnly.scope: This store is outside your store scope, so you can only view it.
settings.store.receipts.hint: The POS starts its receipt numbers again after this period.
settings.store.receipts.label: Receipt numbering
settings.store.receipts.suggestDaily: From the data: the receipt numbers of the last {days} days start again every day, so choose Every day.
settings.store.receipts.suggestNotDaily: From the data: the receipt numbers of the last {days} days do not start again every day, so choose Every year or Never, as the POS is set.
settings.store.seats.hint: Revenue per seat per hour (RevPASH) appears once the seats are set. Leave it empty if unknown.
settings.store.seats.label: Seats
settings.store.tenant.readOnly: Only an owner who sees every store can change the legal form and the default language.
settings.store.tenant.title: Business
settings.store.title: Stores
